evidence_checks: Manifest, generated XML/config, motion metadata, trigger and pose, corroborating base states, contact logs including unnamed G1 geoms

normalization: Verify original full condition hash first; normalize only scene-owned motion values for comparison, preserve robot/provider/behavior rules

planned_random_geometry.limit: Old goal-approach bottleneck remains, not observed failures or physical impossibility; no seed or bound change after audit
